content: “Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Hwa ɣar taddart n ujeǧid n Yahuda, ini din awař-a,
ad tinid: A ajeǧid n Yahuda, wenni iqqimen x řɛarc n Dawud, seř i wawař n SIDI, cek d imsexxaren nnec d řgens nnec i ittadfen zi tewwura-ya!
Ammu i iqqar SIDI: Ggem řḥeqq d tsegda u ssnejmem min ittwakeccḍen zeg ufus n wenni iḥeṣṣaren. War ḥeṣṣarem, war ccatem řbarrani d uyujiř d tajjač. War ssizziřem idammen imezdagen di temmurt-a!

Mařa kenniw ad teggem awař-a s tidett, xenni ad adfen ijeǧiden zi tewwura n tendint-a, inni i ɣa iqqimen ɣar Dawud x řɛarc nnes, inni i ɣa inedhen ikarruten d yeysan, wah, netta d imsexxaren nnes d řgens nnes.
Mařa war tesřim ca ɣar wawařen-a, aqa jjuǧeɣ i Yixef inu, ammu iqqar SIDI, ad tedweř Taddart-a d řxirbet.’”
“Maɣar ammu i iqqar SIDI x taddart n ujeǧid n Yahuda: ‘Waxxa cek tusid ayi x řxaḍar am Jilɛad u am tqiccet n Lubnan, d tidett ad cek tteggeɣ d řexřa, tineddam war izdiɣen.
Necc ad ḥuzeɣ ḍidd nnec imteḥḥayyen, kuř ijj s řesnaḥ nnes i wenɣay. Nitni ad qessen ticejjura nnec n tengelt i icnan aṭṭas s ccwaqar nsen uca ad tent wcen i tmessi.
Xenni ad dd-kken aṭṭas n řegnus x tendint-a, ad inin, kuř ijj i umqarrab nnes: Mayemmi SIDI igga ammu i tendint-a tameqqrant?
Ad inin: Minzi nitni semḥen di Řɛahd n SIDI, AREBBI nsen, uca sejden i irebbiten nneɣni uca dewřen ɛebbden asen.’”
X Callum
“War ttrum x umettin u war xas ccatem agejdur. Rum x wenni yuyuren, maɣar netta ɛemmarṣ ad dd-iɛqeb, ɛemmarṣ ad iẓar ɛad tammurt nnes mani ixřeq.
Maɣar ammu i iqqar SIDI x Callum, mmis n Yuciya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, wenni idewřen d ajeǧid deg wemcan n babas Yuciya, Callum wenni dd-iffɣen zeg wemcan-a: ‘Netta ɛemmarṣ ad dd-iɛqeb dinni ɛad.
Maɣar deg wemcan mani t nedhen di tmeḥbast, dinni i ɣa immet, ɛemmarṣ ad iẓar tammurt-a ɛawed.’”
X Yahuyaqim
“Axeyyeb i wenni i ɣa issbedden tazeddiɣt nnes s řmuɛṣiyyet, tiɣurfin nnes s řɣecc, wenni issxeddamen wenni t yudsen nehřa axeǧeṣ u war d as ittic řmunet nnes,

wenni iqqaren: ‘Necc ad ssbeddeɣ i yixef inu ict n tzeddiɣt yuɛřan aṭṭas s tɣurfin iwesɛen.’ Xenni ad dayes igg tiburjatin uca ad tt iseqqef s ukeccuḍ n tcejjura n tengelt uca ad tt izewweq s tintat tizeggʷaɣin.
Ma tḥekkmed am ujeǧid umi tᵉttemḥizwared zi ssibbet n tneglin? Babac ma war icci, ma war iswi u ma war iggi řḥeqq d tsegda? Netta tuɣa mliḥ xas xenni!
Netta iḥkem tamesřact n wenni ittwaḥṣaren d umezřuḍ. Tuɣa mliḥ xas xenni. Ma aya war ixs ad yini aqa bnadem issen ayi?, ammu i iqqar SIDI.
Maca tiṭṭawin nnec d wuř nnec aqa ten mɣir x tizi nnec waha, x idammen imezdagen maḥend ad ten tessizzřed, u x ddeǧ d ubeɛɛej, maḥend ad ten tegged.”
“S uya, ammu i iqqar SIDI x Yahuyaqim, mmis n Yuciya, ajeǧid n Yahuda: ‘Nitni war xas ceṭṭnen: Ax, uma! niɣ: Ax, učma! Nitni war ceṭṭnen: Ax, sidi! niɣ: Ax, lɛaḍim!
Ad neḍřen s wenḍař n ijj n weɣyuř. Ad t jarren u ad t nḍaren ɣar řaggʷaj, barra i tiwwura n Urcalim.’”
X Kun-Yahu
“Geɛɛed x idurar n Lubnan, sɣuyy uca ejj tmijja nnem ad tᵉttwaseř di Bacan. Sɣuyy-dd ɛawed zi Abarim, maɣar marra inni cem ittexsen ttwarẓan.
Necc ssiwřeɣ akidem řami cem tuɣa di řaman, cem maca tennid: ‘Necc war xseɣ ad sřeɣ!’ Ammu i t teggid zi temẓi nnem, maɣar cem tuɣa war tᵉttexsed ad tesřed i tmijja inu.
Marra imeksawen ad ten yarwes usemmiḍ uca inni cem ittexsen ad uyuren di tmeḥbast. Xenni ad tseḍḥid uca ad tenfeḍḥed zi ssibbet n marra tuɛeffna nnem.
Cem, a tenni izeddɣen x idurar n Lubnan, tenni iḥebḍen di tcejjura n tneglin, mammec i ɣa tzehhared xmi d am dd ɣa yasen řewjeɛ, řeḥriq am yicten tᵉttaru!”
“S tidett am ddareɣ Necc, ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Waxxa, mařa Kun-Yahu, mmis n Yahuyaqim, ajeǧid n Yahuda, tuɣa d txadent n ucemmiɛ deg ufus inu, aqa ad cek kkseɣ ssenni.
Necc ad cek wceɣ deg ufus n yinni yarezzun tudart nnec u deg ufus n wenni zi tᵉtteggʷeded, deg ufus n Nabuxadraṣṣar, ajeǧid n Babil, u deg ufus n Ikaldaniyyen.
Cek d yemmac, ad kenniw nḍareɣ ɣar ict n temmurt nneɣnit mani war texřiqem, uca dinni ad tmetnem.
War ttɛiqqibem ɛemmarṣ ɣar temmurt nni di temmeẓrem maḥend ad ɣares dd-tɛeqbem.’”
“Ma Kun-Yahu aryaz-a d ijj n uɣarraf immenḍar, yarreẓ? Niɣ netta d ijj n uɣarraf war t ittexs ɛad uřa d ijj? Mayemmi t ḥejjaren, netta d zzariɛet nnes, nḍaren ten ɣar ict n temmurt war tt ssinen?
A tammurt, tammurt, tammurt, seř i wawař n SIDI!

Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Zemm aryaz-a nhřa iḥenjiren, ijj n weryaz nni war ɣar iǧi zzhir deg wussan nnes. Maɣar uřa d ijj zeg warraw nnes ad ɣares yiři zzhir ařami i ɣa iqqim x řɛarc n Dawud, ad iḥkem ɛawed di temmurt n Yahuda.’”

footnotes.text: yinni yarezzun tudart nnec- s Tɛibranit ‘n yenni yarezzun řeɛmar nnec’.
